takeaway: A fourth forecast has been scored and the radar's ranking held its level (rank correlation 0.69, 9 of its top 15 right). Design skills for coding agents remain the fastest-moving open category, now joined by taste-skill at 104.8k stars.

findings.heading: Four forecasts scored; the ranking holds its level
findings.text: Rank correlation with the growth that followed: 0.55 (Oct 19), 0.66 (Oct 20), 0.71 (Oct 21), 0.69 (Oct 22). Top-15 hit rate 60% on the last three, against about 25% for random picks of 15 from 61 apps.

findings.heading: The self-tuner held again
findings.text: Over 4 days, weighing stated gains 1.0 to 0.9 raises mean rank correlation from 0.656 to 0.661, better on every day but under the +0.02 bar. Weight caps stay at 1.0.

findings.heading: Design skills: five on the radar now
findings.text: impeccable gained 2,473 stars in a day (to 93,460) and hallmark 1,609. New today: leonxlnx/taste-skill at 104.8k stars (+13,933 in 30 days) and jakubkrehel/skills at 9.1k.

findings.heading: Big tech reports growth rates, not levels
findings.text: Alphabet: the Gemini app is at one billion users, not labelled MAU. Microsoft: Copilot daily users up nearly 50% in a quarter, with no seat count. Read from search results.

findings.heading: A jailbreak-prompt repo grew 26% in a day
findings.text: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks went from 5,983 to 7,536 stars, the fastest relative gain among today's measured movers. It is not judged inorganic.

caveats: Four matured forecasts are still a small sample; the tuner's bar keeps noise-sized gains from moving any setting.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; two rows (one duplicate, one with an inferred date) were dropped before ingest.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
